purpose: Construct an on-shell pressureless first-order standard-matter surrogate on the frozen GE15 R1 metric, initialized from the full CLASS standard-sector density and momentum, and quantify its drift from the full standard sector before using GE07 in H3.

full_standard_state_from_CLASS.delta_rho_std: rho_g delta_g + rho_b delta_b + rho_ur delta_ur + rho_ncdm delta_ncdm
full_standard_state_from_CLASS.momentum_std: (4/3 rho_g) theta_g + rho_b theta_b + (4/3 rho_ur) theta_ur + (rho_ncdm+p_ncdm) theta_ncdm

on_shell_dust_equations_CLASS_convention.initial_condition: at a=1/(1+1.5), match absolute standard-sector delta_rho and momentum for each k

exact_GE07_map.normalization_reason: CLASS background densities use (8piG/3)rho while GE07 varrho=8piG rho

reported_model_errors: central C_star dust versus full standard delta_rho global and pointwise relative error
central C_star dust versus full standard momentum global and pointwise relative error

claim_boundary: PASS certifies the on-shell reduced dust construction and quantifies its first-order model error. It does not declare the reduced model exact or by itself certify a full-species Z20.
anti_tuning: Do not add or relax a model-error acceptance threshold after observing GE18. Model errors are descriptive and must propagate into the later reduced-H3 Z20 envelope.
